hints.title: Nesting Multiplier Observation
hints.text: Observe how every enclosing layer of brackets doubles the internal point contribution.

hints.title: Atomic Pair Evaluation
hints.text: Every atomic adjacent open-close pair contributes two raised to the current nesting depth.

hints.title: Bit Shift Depth Addition
hints.text: Increment a depth counter on open brackets and decrement on close brackets. Add one shifted left by depth when closing an immediate opening bracket.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Single pass tracking current nesting depth and bit shifting for atomic pairs.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full string parsing and recursive sub-expression evaluation incurs unnecessary string allocations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that only immediate () pairs contribute power-of-two scores.
